text: Objectives We wish to instill in our students a good sense of social responsibilities and professional ethics while maintaining good health and a sound mind. The program provides students with solid theory as well as the latest technological knowledge. Our students are encouraged to be independent, innovative, and internationally competent. Students are expected to be able to engaged in high level research, and assume leadership role in the fields. Duration Duration of the program is between 1.5 to 2 years. Research Areas 1. Optical Information Technology 2. Optical Detection and Imaging 3. Micro Nano Photonics Credit Units Research-orientated students need to successfully complete at least 32 credits with minimum 19 credits for degree courses. Application-orientated students need to successfully complete at least 33 credits with minimum 17 credits for degree courses. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship
